insights.title: 63.33% Baseline Cohort Placement
insights.summary: Out of 1,500 total students, 950 secured placements while 550 remain unplaced.

insights.title: Civil Engineering Leads Branch Placement
insights.summary: CE achieved the highest placement rate at 68.57% (72/105), while Mechanical Engineering was lowest at 55.83% (67/120).

insights.title: SQL Shows Highest Placement Spread
insights.summary: SQL holders exhibit a +9.17 pp higher placement rate than non-holders, followed by Python (+6.94 pp) and Cloud (+6.04 pp).

insights.title: Product Companies Lead Package Premium
insights.summary: Product firms offer highest average package (16.26 LPA mean, 16.03 LPA median) compared to Service firms (5.90 LPA mean).

insights.title: Coding & Aptitude Show Strongest Deltas
insights.summary: Placed students average +5.41 points higher in coding (78.36 vs 72.95) and +5.19 points higher in aptitude (75.40 vs 70.21).

insights.title: High Readiness Tiers Achieve >84% Placement
insights.summary: Students in High Readiness tier (PRI 80-100) achieve 84.15% placement, whereas High Imp Priority (<40) achieve 50.00%.
